text:
frank_pd: quick thread - we need to decide SLA cutover behavior when we enable burst-credit amortization and reserved-pool hysteresis together. Customers will notice different accounting vs actual capacity.
anya: core ask from field: make billing/console reflect the "effective" capacity customers can rely on, not just raw tokens consumed.
lucy_ops: ops needs an event model: when amortization applies, show two numbers: Allocated (runtime) vs Billable(amortized). must surface reclaim windows.
darren_eng: runtime note: we can tag requests as using amortized-credit vs live-reserved. adding two counters tile is cheap. harder part is when to show "guaranteed" vs "best-effort" in UI.
billing-bot: FYI: any change to displayed billable amounts pre-commit requires a billing migration and a communication plan.
frank_pd: proposal: during pilot show three fields: AllocatedCapacity, BillingEstimate(windowed), SafetyNotice if reclaimable. Keep SLA text unchanged until GA.
anya: launch checklist:
- UI: new dashboard tiles + tooltip language
- Runtime: request tagging + metrics
- Billing: estimate job for windowed amortization (read-only for pilot)
- Legal: pilot comms and sample contract wording
lucy_ops: canary plan: 10 tenants, 7d, compare Allocated vs BillingEstimate drift and surface anomalies.
darren_eng: timeline: tagging + dashboard = 2 sprints; billing read-only estimate = 3 sprints. legal + sales prep parallel.
frank_pd: decision: move forward with pilot visibility-only (no invoice changes). owners: darren=eng, lucy=ops, anya=bizops. will review canary metrics next sprint.
